note: C-15 / C-19 (deny by evidence): the AI door's slice, the default since C-19 (NML_CORE_SLICE=allow is the way back; the human door keeps the allow file until DS-109). A unit carrying a listed primitive (unit or weapon rule) stays on the table; every other rule the registry automates goes to the core. Unknown or unautomated rules stay refused in both modes. Measured in the 24-game shadow soak of 17.11. (wave1116/shadow_soak_C6.md); the list only shrinks.
unmapped_inert_why: A rule name no rules map knows for the unit's system and faction (an upgrade's own label such as Wandering Mystic, War Paint, Combat Shield): the registry gives neither side anything to read, and the rules the upgrade grants are carried and checked on their own.

inert.Unique: A list-building restriction only (army book); no effect on a volley.
inert.Army Standard Bearer: An upgrade's own label; the rules it grants (Fear(2)) are carried and checked on their own.
inert.Courage: The bare base the Courage Aura expansion stamps; no map entry on either side - the +1 morale rides the aura's own Banner entry.

deny_names.Experimental Tinctures: Measured (5-seed sweep): 25 taken volleys at Zairetia, the core opens a 12 in shot the table refuses; refused by name until diagnosed.
deny_names.Gleaming Armour: Measured (5-seed sweep): 5 taken volleys, the target's Defense differs by one.
deny_names.Fortified Aura: door omits the table's aura-loss line (`_solo_fortified_aura_loss_log`) when the bearer dies, dlines_gap row 21: the Fortified line itself is said since dlines2 train 2.
deny_names.Guardian Boost Aura: door omits the table's aura-loss line (`_solo_fortified_aura_loss_log`) when the bearer dies, dlines_gap row 21: the Fortified line itself is said since dlines2 train 2.
deny_names.Grounded Protection: door omits the table's terrain trace (Grounded Protection) or once-per-game lines (Protection Feat), dlines_gap row 3; the roll, bypass and Warding gate lines are said since dlines2/3.
deny_names.Enhanced Knightborn: the table names the roll group by whichever of Knightborn / Enhanced Knightborn is live at the shot's distance (the gated Knightborn folds nothing within 9in); the core's group name is static, dlines_gap row 3.
deny_names.Protection Feat: door omits the table's terrain trace (Grounded Protection) or once-per-game lines (Protection Feat), dlines_gap row 3; the roll, bypass and Warding gate lines are said since dlines2/3.

door_omits_unstoppable_fold_line.why: A shooter with an Unstoppable weapon at a target whose rules lower the to-hit number (Stealth and its aliases such as Changebound and Stealth Aura, Evasive, Artillery, Aircraft): the table says `Unstoppable: negative to-hit modifiers ignored` when the weapon swallows the minus (`_solo_unstoppable_fold`), the core says it only for the granted mark and aura (dice.rs: a weapon's own flag stays silent). The dice are equal (stealth_target_door_test.gd, 8 taken Changebound volleys of the 1000 pts census). Not a rule name: `CoreSlice.pair_refusals` refuses the PAIR, switched on by this group.
door_omits_unstoppable_fold_line.leaves_with: the core saying the table's Unstoppable fold line for a weapon's own Unstoppable

ledger_not_round_tripped.why: Their marker pools / once-per-game stamps do not come back from the core's delta yet (slice design 1d). Hit & Run and Hit & Run Shooter lifted again (HR-POS): the delta carries the stepped positions and the table lands them (door probe 8/8). Growth Markers lifted: the growth count rides the delta (C-13), the joined hero's AP is folded on the table (DS-PG), and the door says the family's four lines (door_lines_growth_test).
ledger_not_round_tripped.leaves_with: C-12 / C-13 and the activation-level steps

pre_attack_beat_twice.why: The table resolves a bearer's pre-attack beat in main.gd before the volley, and the core, which takes the whole activation, resolves it again from the board it captured before that beat. Measured 19.11. (one real AI activation per seed, deny slice, door on against door off, 8 seeds each): Mend 8/8 and Breath Attack 8/8 roll the beat's die twice (a second Blast volley on 7/8), Mind Control (also Fatigue Debuff) 8/8 rolls its morale test twice, Storm Attack 8/8 rolls its trigger dice twice, Reckless Piercing 8/8 rolls its die twice, and the Utility Buff family leaves a stale once-record or marker behind on the table 8/8 (Precision Shooter Buff: a record the core already spent; Precision Tag: a tag marker). The family is one primitive, so its Casting Buff, Precision Target and Precision Spotter (each measured equal, 8/8) and Re-Position Artillery (not measured) go with it. Piercing Tag, Piercing Target and Piercing Spotter (primitive Piercing Tag) run in the same slot but measured equal 8/8 and stay taken (LD-6).

door_omits_simultaneous_fire_line.why: A shooter with a Deadly weapon beside another ranged weapon (its joined heroes' included): the table lands Deadly inline, so a later weapon sees fewer models and says `Simultaneous fire: ...` or Blast's cap read when the volley started; the core lands after the dice and writes neither. Not a rule name: `CoreSlice` refuses it by predicate (`deadly_beside_other_weapons`), switched on by this group. Measured 19.11.: 29 volleys, dlines_gap row 18.
door_omits_simultaneous_fire_line.leaves_with: the dlines2 train that lands Deadly inline on the step path

door_own_shred_beside_alias.why: A weapon's own Shred beside a unit-level Shred rule of another name (Warbound, Destroyer, Infected, ...) is two rules in the table (R-1 A2: each pays its extra wounds, the alias gated by distance); the core pays the unmodified 1s once, so the target's wounds differ (5 of 12 seeds, dlines3 door test). Not a rule name: `CoreSlice` refuses it by predicate (`own_shred_beside_alias`), switched on by this group; a state difference, so the dice-only pin keeps it.
door_own_shred_beside_alias.leaves_with: the core paying the own part and the alias part apart (R-1 A2 on the step path)

door_omits_armor_line.why: The table names a target's Armor(X) before the announce (`<U> has Armor(X): counts as Defense N+`); the core applies it and writes no line. Measured 19.11.: 3 volleys at 1500 and at 2000 pts, dlines_gap row 23.
door_omits_armor_line.leaves_with: the dlines3 train that says the Armor line

door_versatile_pick_modified_to_hit.why: The table latches a Versatile Attack pick (+1 to hit or AP(+1)) on the MODIFIED to-hit number of the activation's first volley; the core's latch reads the plain Quality (`sim::versatile_latch`, its `hit_target`). When a to-hit modifier is in play (Artillery, a Stealth or Evasive family rule, Aircraft on the target; Artillery, a Shot Modifier, Instinctive on the shooter) the two can pick differently and the dice and the target's wounds differ (door probe, Vinci Tech Quality 4 AP(1) at Defense 3+: 12 of 12 seeds against Stealth, Evasive and Artillery, 8 of 12 with a different end state; 3000 pts roster sweep: 6 volleys). Not a rule name: `CoreSlice.pair_refusals` refuses the PAIR, switched on by this group; a state difference, so the dice-only pin keeps it.
door_versatile_pick_modified_to_hit.leaves_with: the Versatile latch reading the volley's modified to-hit number instead of the plain Quality

door_takedown_names_an_equipment_carrier.why: The table names the picked model of a Takedown by its label (`_solo_model_label`): Tough(X) model, the last of several weapons, else the model's FIRST ITEM (`Takedown (<w>): targets the Banner in <U>`); the core carries only an item count per model, so it writes `trooper`. Measured in a door test (Takedown at a unit with one Banner carrier: 12 of 12 seeds differ). Not a rule name: `CoreSlice.pair_refusals` refuses a Takedown shooter at a target with a living item-carrying model, switched on by this group.
door_takedown_names_an_equipment_carrier.leaves_with: the capture carrying the item NAMES of a model's kit
